assertion_results.text: Recommends notifications (not AtCollection) for high-frequency sensor data
assertion_results.evidence: "For sensor readings sent every few seconds, **use the Notifications + SQLite pattern** — not `AtCollection<T>`."

assertion_results.text: Provides reasoning based on frequency/volume threshold
assertion_results.evidence: "Overwhelm the atServer sync mechanism (not designed for sustained >~10 writes/second)" and decision checklist row "Is volume > ~10 writes/second? Potentially yes"
